# Verifies a user-defined func that mutates state from outside a direct
# event handler still triggers DOM updates.
#
# Phase 2 pipeline (g.updates rip) emits:
#   - user func body inlines per-assignment DOM patches (NoReactivity lowering):
#       function update(newName, newCount) {
#         state.name = newName;
#         __n0.textContent = state.name;
#         state.count = newCount;
#         __n1.textContent = String(state.count);
#       }
#   - click handler calls update("Hello", 5).
#   - __sngl_init() inlines the initial DOM writes (no per-prop $u_* funcs).
#
# legacy does NOT emit a separate $set_name(v) function — mutations are
# inlined at each assignment site within the user func.

sngl compile --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# User func is emitted with both state mutations and inlined DOM patches.
grep 'function main_update' out/index.html
grep 'state\d*\.name = newName' out/index.html
grep 'state\d*\.count = newCount' out/index.html
grep '__n0.textContent = state.name' out/index.html
grep '__n1.textContent = String\(state.count\)' out/index.html

# Per-prop init-only updaters collapsed into __sngl_init — no $u_* funcs.
! grep '\$u__n0_text' out/index.html
! grep '\$u__n1_text' out/index.html
grep 'function __sngl_init' out/index.html

# Button click handler calls user func.
grep 'main_update\(state, "Hello", 5\)' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
output { none { html } }

component main {
    var name = "World"
    var count int = 0

    func update(newName string, newCount int) {
        name = newName
        count = newCount
    }

    text(value=name)
    text(value=string(count))
    button(text="Update", @click { update("Hello", 5) })
}
